mediaWork.title: Wrongful Conviction: Junk Science
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Sub-series of Wrongful Conviction dissecting discredited forensic methods (bite marks, arson, hair microscopy, bloodstain patterns, footwear) that caused wrongful convictions.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Hosted by civil rights attorney and innocence advocate Josh Dubin (Lava for Good), examining how unvalidated forensic disciplines led to wrongful convictions across the United States.
